title: Colour revolution
extract: The colour revolutions are a series of protests and attempted or successful changes of government and society, particularly in post-Soviet states or states allied to Russia. The aim of colour revolutions is to establish liberal democracy, in opposition to corruption, autocracy and authoritarianism. They have often been triggered by election results widely viewed as falsified.
